current.title: ✨  Teamwork Month! ✨
current.author: Aivaras Baltuskonis
current.html:
Hi everyone!!

As we are now well into our 2nd Values in Action month, it is well overdue that we share this month’s value is Teamwork. The main objective of the Teamwork value is for us all to remember we are one team.


This can be a fragmented time of year with many people on annual leave, and each of us trying to balance life and work the best we can. It is so important that we band together with our colleagues at times like this. To maintain results-focus, we need to…

✨ Support each other

✨ Listen and keep an open mind

✨ Act fairly and take responsibility for our part

✨ Take account of other people’s workloads and pressures

✨ Ask for help and be willing to compromise

✨ Ensure we are fulfilling our obligations

We have seen a huge increase in Teamwork thanks on the Thanks app, and we wanted to share some more appreciations from across the group..

As a great example of Teamwork, Tailored Image and Cooneen at Work had both chased a new opportunity in the transport sector in the UK. We both got through to the final stage of the tender process. After the announcement that Tailored Image were joining the Cooneen family, we worked together, to cherry pick the best of both companies, to put our best foot forward. We worked collaboratively with openness and positivity, to give us the best chance of winning this new business.

#Teamworkmakesthedreamwork

Ryan McClintock, FMT – Business Development


As I have been temporarily working remotely, the team in CBD have been really supportive. There have been lots of check-ins and everyone has made an effort to keep me updated and make sure I still feel part of the team. I’ve really appreciated being kept involved in conversations and being able to easily reach out to everyone when I need anything. Even though I’m not in the office, I still feel very much part of the team, which I think is a great example of Teamwork.


Elle Hardy, Manchester - CBD


When on annual leave Vanessa Doyle became the main point of contact for the team, this was in addition to her normal workload. This allowed me to enjoy my break knowing the team was supported in my absence and gave the team stability during this time also.


Claire Flannagan, FMT – CAW


The Warehouse move from Amesbury to Wrexham, was built on Teamwork, commitment, and a shared determination to succeed. Everyone played their part, supported each other and overcame challenges together.

The move is just the beginning. Our next exciting step is the implementation of a Warehouse Management System (WMS), building on what we’ve achieved and taking our operation to the next level.


Marlene Bogue, FMT - IT Program Manager


A great example of Teamwork was demonstrated while Alvyn was on annual leave for two weeks. During this period, Brendan stepped up and took responsibility for part of Alvyn's workload, while I covered the remaining tasks. This support was invaluable in ensuring that all MOD deliveries and day-to-day operations continued without disruption. Through effective collaboration and Teamwork, we successfully maintained service levels, and everything ran smoothly throughout Alvyn's absence.

Another great example of Teamwork was demonstrated while Anthony was on annual leave for a week. During his absence, Katie and Alvyn stepped up and worked together to ensure that all PSNI orders were processed and dispatched on time. Their commitment and support helped maintain a smooth operation, ensuring there was no disruption to service and that customer requirements continued to be met successfully.


Jason Sharpe, FMT - Warehouse Manager


Over the past few months, the production team has demonstrated Teamwork, stepping into different areas to support production, learn new skills, and ensure workloads are balanced across the factory.

A special mention goes to Anita, Belinda, and Diana, who moved from batching into sewing and successfully trained to become sewing operators. Their adaptability and Teamwork has made a real difference.


Emma Kirwan, FMT - Group Operations Manager


This month has been one of our busiest periods, with the expansion into the new half of the warehouse alongside the onboarding of several new contracts. This has significantly increased both workload and setup activities across the operation. The team has worked together to create new pallet locations, move stock to and from storage, establish new pick faces, and ensure they are fully stocked and ready to support demand. We have also faced challenges with replenishment, as one of our three reach trucks is often required for incoming and outgoing wagons. Despite this, the team coordinated effectively to share two reach trucks between three replenishers, ensuring stock continued to flow and pick faces remained replenished. Despite the additional pressure, constant changes, and equipment constraints, the team remained flexible, proactive, and committed to delivering results. Through strong communication and collaboration, we successfully supported new contract launches, and maintained high service levels, consistently pushing towards 1,000 despatches per day.‌


Bobby Beaumount,  Wrexham - CAW


Please continue to thank your colleagues on the thanks app for Teamwork contributions throughout August as we may have some more surprises in store … EyesParty

Go Team!!! Fist bump
